item.title: Searching Without Being Searched: The Architecture of Oblivious Prefix Trees
item.description: A rigorous analysis of Prefix Trees (Tries) and Radix Trees, evolving from memory hierarchy constraints to cryptographically secure Data-Oblivious architectures.

item.title: The Mathematics of Dense Vector Search
item.description: A comprehensive deep dive into the mathematical foundations and algorithms of modern vector search, including HNSW, DiskANN, Quantization, and the Curse of Dimensionality.
